verdict.rationale: The official CLI README documents both install scopes in a scope table. Project scope is the default, writes to `./<agent>/skills/`, and is 'committed with your project, shared with team'. Global scope uses the `-g` flag, writes to `~/<agent>/skills/`, and is 'available across all projects'. Worked examples use `-g`, and a skills-lock.json restore command supports reproducing installs in a repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the `-g` versus project-local scope behaves as documented (the runtime probes did not exercise scope).
